reviews.review:
This game has received a lot of hate which honestly I can't understand. 

Is it the best type of coop-shooter out there? No.

Is it the best Aliens game? Certainly not.

Did I enjoy it so far? Hell yes!

It is basicly a Left 4 Dead with Aliens. You have a skill and progression system that isn't too grindy and getting all weapons and a basic set of attachements is fun. Customizing weapons makes a little difference.

Skillwise you can customize a bit but you mostly go for making the best out of them rather then variety.

Now to the Aliens:
There was a big fuzz about the aliens being nothing more than cannonfodder. If you expect a Alien Isolation type xenomorph you will be disappointed. These Aliens are in full berserk and hive defense mode.

The regular xenomorphs are your swarm type. It is more like the dog alien from alien 3. Smaller and less intimidating than your typical "human bread" alien.

Then you have Drones. They are a little more "cunning" Attacking you and also retreating and coming from other holes behind you. THAT is your typcal xenomorph you know and love.
When introduced in the campaign they litterally say "That's the one that comes from humans".

There is several other types like spitters, suicide acid bomb, tanks and juggernaut type aliens. Experience them yourself.

If you hate AI and synths, you will be served, since those are sometimes enemies as well and they shoot back (hence the cover system).

The campaign introduces you to the game and after you played through on the initial difficulty you get the recon class and quick play.

That is when you at least want to go up a notch to play in intimidating. Believe me, that is when the game starts to be fun.
Why? Aliens are slightly stronger and annoying and also friendly fire starts to affect you. Just slightly but you feel it. In higher difficulties you have to work as a team and you have the claustrophobic alien feeling. Think before you shoot or your teammate might go down.

There is a Tunnel type hallway? Very narrow?
Send your Demolisher with the smartgun or flamethrower, or your phalanx. 
It is in the higher difficulties when weapons and team composition will start to matter.

I recommend playing intimidating at least with one human player and one synth (bot). You will have most fun playing this game with friends on teamspeak on difficulty intimidating or higher.

If you want to spice it up even more you have challenge cards that "mutate" the gameplay either giving you a buff, or more fun, making it harder for more rewards.

Get this game on sale and give it an honest try. Don't listen to the haters.
If you know what you are getting into it is a fun casual shooter in the Alien Universe.

Repetitive and lots of bugs. Waited in a queue for 5 mins only to get bots and when I did get to team up with others I got kicked from the game half way through. For a game that came out months ago small bugs like this should have been fixed.

Pros:

- Good graphics
- Enjoyable gameplay
- Various firearms
- Challenges 
- Smooth game performance
- Almost no bugs
- Great Co-op experience

Cons:

- Short campaign
- Story was meh
- No boss fights

Great game playing with friends for some hours, mowing down hordes of xenos and synths. :D
It is a grind like many of the other games of this genre, but at least its the aliens version. It still scares me sometimes lol
